mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( ( SELECT A.MHS_CONNSEQ, C.MHS_CLASSROOMNM, C.MHS_CLASSNM, C.MHS_TEACHERNM, C.MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY, C.MHS_CLASSENDDAY, C.MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK, C.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME, C.MHS_CLASSENDTIME, C.MHS_CLASSINTRO, 'NOW' AS MHSNOWGUBUN FROM TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO A JOIN TB_MHSMONITORINFO B ON A.MHS_MONITORCD = B.MHS_MONITORCD JOIN TB_MHSCLASSINFO C ON A.MHS_CLASSCD = C.MHS_CLASSCD WHERE C.MHS_CLASSSTATUS != 'N' AND A.MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd} AND #{searchDay} BETWEEN C.MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY AND C.MHS_CLASSENDDAY AND C.MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK ~ TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{searchDay}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'D') AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'HH24MI') BETWEEN C.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME AND C.MHS_CLASSENDTIME ORDER BY C.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME ASC, A.MHS_CONNSEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT A.MHS_CONNSEQ, C.MHS_CLASSROOMNM, C.MHS_CLASSNM, C.MHS_TEACHERNM, C.MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY, C.MHS_CLASSENDDAY, C.MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK, C.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME, C.MHS_CLASSENDTIME, C.MHS_CLASSINTRO, 'NEXT' AS MHSNOWGUBUN FROM TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO A JOIN TB_MHSMONITORINFO B ON A.MHS_MONITORCD = B.MHS_MONITORCD JOIN TB_MHSCLASSINFO C ON A.MHS_CLASSCD = C.MHS_CLASSCD WHERE C.MHS_CLASSSTATUS != 'N' AND A.MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd} AND #{searchDay} BETWEEN C.MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY AND C.MHS_CLASSENDDAY AND C.MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK ~ TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{searchDay}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'D') AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'HH24MI') < C.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME ORDER BY C.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME ASC, A.MHS_CONNSEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) TA ORDER BY MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME ASC

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO A JOIN TB_MHSMONITORINFO B ON A.MHS_MONITORCD = B.MHS_MONITORCD JOIN TB_MHSCLASSINFO C ON A.MHS_CLASSCD = C.MHS_CLASSCD WHERE TO_CHAR(A.MHS_DATAUPDATEDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') > TO_CHAR(COALESCE(A.MHSDATAUPDATEPLAYDATE, TO_TIMESTAMP('20190101 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')), 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND A.MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd} AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN C.MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY AND C.MHS_CLASSENDDAY AND C.MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK ~ TO_CHAR(TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD')::DATE, 'D')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO ( MHS_CONNSEQ, MHS_MONITORCD, MHS_CLASSCD, MHS_DATAUPDATEYN, MHSDATAUPDATEPLAYDATE, MHS_DATAREGID, MHS_DATAREGDATE, MHS_DATAUPDATEID, MHS_DATAUPDATEDATE, MHS_DATASTATUS ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('mhsconn_seq'), #{mhsMonitorcd}, #{mhsClasscd}, 'N', NULL, #{mhsDataregid}, NOW(), #{mhsDataregid}, NOW(), 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO SET MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd}, MHS_CLASSCD = #{mhsClasscd}, MHS_DATAUPDATEYN = 'N', MHSDATAUPDATEPLAYDATE = NULL, MHS_DATAUPDATEID = #{mhsDataregid}, MHS_DATAUPDATEDATE = NOW(), MHS_DATASTATUS = 'Y' WHERE MHS_CLASSCD = #{mhsClasscd}

UPDATE TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO SET MHSDATAUPDATEPLAYDATE = NULL WHERE MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd} AND 1 = ( SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(MHS_LASTCONN, 'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM TB_MHSMONITORINFO WHERE MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd} )
UPDATE TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO SET MHSDATAUPDATEPLAYDATE = NOW(), MHS_DATAUPDATEYN = 'Y' WHERE MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd}
UPDATE TB_MHSVIEWCONNINFO SET MHSDATAUPDATEPLAYDATE = NULL, MHS_DATAUPDATEYN = 'N' WHERE MHS_CLASSCD = #{mhsClasscd}
